name: RuneScape: Dragonwilds Dedicated Server
description: Install the RuneScape: Dragonwilds dedicated server through SteamCMD, launch its official server executable directly, and manage its owner, server, world, and password settings.
known_limitations: GameNode edits OwnerId, ServerName, DefaultWorldName, AdminPassword, and WorldPassword in DedicatedServer.ini. Other settings, and the ServerGuid and admin history the server writes itself, are left untouched.
The server creates DedicatedServer.ini on its first run and exits without a valid OwnerId. Start it once, fill in the values under Configuration while it is stopped, then start it again.
The server overwrites DedicatedServer.ini while running. Edit it only while stopped.

Servers provisioned from template version 1.0.0 or 1.1.0 have the wrong launch executable (an earlier version guessed a path that does not exist in the depot) and must be reprovisioned; GameNode never migrates an existing server's pinned launch.
Automatic updates, backups, and world migration are outside this template.

ports.name: Game
ports.purpose: Dragonwilds dedicated-server port; additional instances use subsequent ports

config_files.description: Windows Unreal server settings including OwnerId, ServerName, DefaultWorldName, AdminPassword, and WorldPassword.
Linux Unreal server settings including OwnerId, ServerName, DefaultWorldName, AdminPassword, and WorldPassword.

requirements.description: Anonymous SteamCMD installation is confirmed to work for this App ID; no Steam login is required.
The reviewed Windows and Linux builds target x86-64 hosts.
The Windows depot is roughly 5 GB and the Linux depot roughly 5.5 GB; ensure sufficient storage for the server build and world saves.

help.summary: GameNode installs SteamCMD App ID 4019830 and launches the native Windows or Linux Dragonwilds server binary.
notes: Start the server once so it creates DedicatedServer.ini, stop it, then set the Owner ID, server name, world name, and admin password in GameNode's Configuration tab and start it again.
Owner ID is your in-game Player ID, shown at the bottom of the Settings menu.
Forward UDP 7777 for the first instance; later instances use subsequent ports.

findings.summary: The server will not start as usable without the owner's in-game Player ID in OwnerId.

prerequisites: Network access to Steam content servers during installation
An amd64 Windows or Linux host
A Dragonwilds Player ID for OwnerId
